{{Top|leg}}
The '''Test''' was a [[Yapi]] ritual to test a being's worthiness. Armed with only a club, the candidate was faced with six large jars in a ten-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] deep pit. Five of the jars were empty, but the sixth contained a [[Maoi]], an amorphous lifeform that attacked prey by slithering down the throat and devouring the internal organs. Without testing the jars&mdash;although sensing them through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] or [[Ta-Ree]] magic was permitted&mdash;the candidate had to smash at least two jars without releasing the Maoi. The more jars that were smashed, the more the candidate was considered worthy.
